thread:
Noah: Quick heads-up: I kicked off an exploratory run for draft-pioneer-13b quantized (QAT6) with an opportunistic speculative path. Preliminary numbers look promising: ~2.3x token throughput on short-chat workloads, P95 token latency improved ~18%.
Aisha: nice. Did you use the new scoring heuristic (entropy-weighted reranker) or the old logprob ranking?
Noah: entropy-weighted reranker + length-normalized logit sum. Config below: 
```
MODEL=draft-pioneer-13b
QUANT=q6
DECODE=strategy:speculative,depth:3,scoring:entropy_weighted,alpha:0.6,prefetch_window:96
KV_WARMUP=true
BATCHER=batch_size:16,max_tokens:1024
```
Run id: exp-pioneer-spec-20260322-a.
Connor: any quality hits on longer summaries or code-gen tasks?
Noah: yeah on code-gen we saw a dip: compile-able rate down ~1.2% on our codebench. But for chat and short completion it's within tolerance.
lytics-bot: perf snapshot uploaded -> dashboard: /perf/exp-pioneer-spec-20260322-a (tokens/s, p50/p95, fallback-rate).
Aisha: let's isolate failure modes: is the reranker promoting high-entropy-but-incorrect candidates? Maybe tune alpha down to 0.4.
Noah: good call. Also curious about prefix length effect. Hypothesis: longer prefixes increase mismatch between candidate KV states causing mid-sequence divergence. Add prefix bucket test: {32,128,512}.
Connor: ops note: when we run prefix=512 we should bump mem-limit, these runs OOMed last time.
ops-bot: resource advisory: run exp-pioneer-spec-20260322-a2 scheduled on dedicated pool 'spec-large' with mem_limit increased to 48GB.
Noah: I'll queue ablation: depth {1,2,3} x alpha {0.4,0.6} x prefix {32,128,512} x fallback_threshold {0.2,0.35}.
Aisha: for eval metrics track: compile-rate (code), exact-match (qa), human factuality (100 samples), ROUGE for summarization, and delta-entropy distribution. Also log top-3 candidate score deltas per step.
Connor: minor UX ask: can console show speculative fallback traces per-request? It'd help triage.
Noah: added an instrumentation ticket. I'll also stash the top-3 candidate tokens stream in S3 for failing samples.
Aisha: acceptance criteria proposal: no more than 0.75% absolute drop in compile-rate and human factuality drop <=0.6 points. If exceeded, disable speculative by default for model in hosted catalog.
Noah: agreed. Will post results tomorrow. :rocket:
